--// RACE CLICKER FARM
--// AUTO FARM: ON / OFF
--// SPEED: 100M

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local SPEED = 100000000
local Enabled = false
local NormalSpeed = 16

--// INTRO
local IntroGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

--// ROOT
local function GetRoot()
    local Character = Player.Character
    if not Character then return nil end
    return Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

--// SPEED
local function ApplySpeed()
    if not Enabled then return end

    local Root = GetRoot()
    if not Root then return end

    local Character = Root.Parent
    local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if Humanoid then
        pcall(function()
            Humanoid.WalkSpeed = SPEED
        end)
    end

    pcall(function()
        local Look = Root.CFrame.LookVector

        Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
            Look.X * SPEED,
            Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y,
            Look.Z * SPEED
        )
    end)
end

--// BUSCAR CARRERA
local function FindRacePart()

    local Root = GetRoot()
    if not Root then return nil end

    local Best = nil
    local BestDistance = math.huge

    for _,Object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do

        if Object:IsA("BasePart") then

            local Name = Object.Name:lower()

            if Name:find("race")
            or Name:find("start")
            or Name:find("begin")
            or Name:find("join") then

                local Distance =
                    (Object.Position - Root.Position).Magnitude

                if Distance < BestDistance then
                    BestDistance = Distance
                    Best = Object
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return Best
end

--// ENTRAR EN LA CARRERA
local function JoinRace()

    if not Enabled then return end

    local Root = GetRoot()
    if not Root then return end

    local RacePart = FindRacePart()

    if RacePart then

        pcall(function()
            Root.CFrame =
                RacePart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,4,0)
        end)

    end
end

--// PARAR VELOCIDAD
local function StopSpeed()

    local Root = GetRoot()
    if not Root then return end

    local Humanoid =
        Root.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if Humanoid then
        pcall(function()
            Humanoid.WalkSpeed = NormalSpeed
        end)
    end

    pcall(function()
        Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end)
end

--// BUSCAR PUNTO SEGURO
local function FindSafePlace()

    local Root = GetRoot()
    if not Root then return nil end

    local Best = nil
    local BestDistance = math.huge

    for _,Object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do

        if Object:IsA("BasePart") then

            local Name = Object.Name:lower()

            if Name:find("safe")
            or Name:find("spawn")
            or Name:find("lobby")
            or Name:find("finish")
            or Name:find("home") then

                local Distance =
                    (Object.Position - Root.Position).Magnitude

                if Distance < BestDistance then
                    BestDistance = Distance
                    Best = Object
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return Best
end

--// IR AL PUNTO SEGURO AL APAGAR
local function GoSafe()

    task.wait(0.2)

    local Root = GetRoot()
    if not Root then return end

    local Safe = FindSafePlace()

    if Safe then

        pcall(function()
            Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            Root.CFrame =
                Safe.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,4,0)
        end)

    end
end

--// ON / OFF
Toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    Enabled = not Enabled

    if Enabled then

        Toggle.Text = "AUTO FARM: ON"
        Toggle.BackgroundColor3 =
            Color3.fromRGB(35,150,85)

        local Humanoid =
            Player.Character and
            Player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

        if Humanoid then
            NormalSpeed = Humanoid.WalkSpeed
        end

        ApplySpeed()
        JoinRace()

    else

        Toggle.Text = "AUTO FARM: OFF"
        Toggle.BackgroundColor3 =
            Color3.fromRGB(55,55,65)

        StopSpeed()
        GoSafe()

    end
end)

--// AUTO FARM LOOP
task.spawn(function()

    while Gui.Parent do

        if Enabled then

            ApplySpeed()

            task.wait(0.15)

            JoinRace()

        end

        task.wait(0.15)
    end

end)

--// RESPAWN
Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()

    task.wait(1)

    if Enabled then
        ApplySpeed()
        JoinRace()
    end

end)

scripts.title: directional backflip (visual)
scripts.script:
local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local rs = game:GetService("RunService")
local jb = 14

local function setup(char)
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local joint = root:WaitForChild("RootJoint")
	local c0 = joint.C0
	local on = false

	local function stop()
		if on then
			rs:UnbindFromRenderStep("backflip")
			on = false
		end
		if joint.Parent then
			joint.C0 = c0
		end
	end

	hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, new)
		if new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed or new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running then
			if on then
				stop()
			end
			return
		end
		if new ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then return end
		stop()
		on = true
		local md0 = hum.MoveDirection
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
		local look = Vector3.new(cam.LookVector.X, 0, cam.LookVector.Z).Unit
		local right = Vector3.new(cam.RightVector.X, 0, cam.RightVector.Z).Unit
		local dir
		if md0.Magnitude < 0.1 then
			dir = -Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z).Unit
		else
			local f = md0:Dot(look)
			local r = md0:Dot(right)
			if math.abs(f) >= math.abs(r) then
				dir = f > 0 and look or -look
			else
				dir = r > 0 and right or -right
			end
		end
		local axis = root.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.yAxis:Cross(dir)).Unit
		local g = workspace.Gravity
		local v = (hum.UseJumpPower and hum.JumpPower or math.sqrt(2 * g * hum.JumpHeight)) + jb
		local dur = math.max(2 * v / g * 0.95, 0.35)
		local t0 = os.clock()
		local boosted = false
		rs:BindToRenderStep("backflip", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, function()
			local a = (os.clock() - t0) / dur
			if a >= 1 or hum.Health <= 0 or not root.Parent then
				stop()
				return
			end
			if not boosted then
				boosted = true
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity += Vector3.new(0, jb, 0)
			end
			joint.C0 = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis, a * math.pi * 2) * c0
		end)
	end)
end

if plr.Character then
	task.spawn(setup, plr.Character)
end
plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(setup)

-- Educational UI Concept for Reset-Safe State Persistence
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Create a ScreenGui
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "PersistentFlightGui"
-- CRUCIAL: Stops Roblox from deleting this UI when you die
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false 
ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Main Container Frame
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 200)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0.4, 0)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
MainFrame.Active = true 
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

-- ==========================================
-- MOBILE FINGER & MOUSE DRAGGING ENGINE
-- ==========================================
local dragging = false
local dragInput, dragStart, startPos

local function update(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
        startPos.X.Scale, 
        startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 
        startPos.Y.Scale, 
        startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
    )
end

MainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

MainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        update(input)
    end
end)
-- ==========================================

-- Minimize / Maximize Toggle Button
local MinBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
MinBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 25)
MinBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 0, 5)
MinBtn.Text = "-"
MinBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 30, 30)
MinBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
MinBtn.Parent = MainFrame

-- Flight Toggle Button
local FlightButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
FlightButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 195, 0, 30)
FlightButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 5)
FlightButton.Text = "FLY (ENABLE)"
FlightButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 180)
FlightButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
FlightButton.Parent = MainFrame

-- Directional Controls Frame
local ControlFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
ControlFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 150)
ControlFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 45)
ControlFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ControlFrame.Visible = false
ControlFrame.Parent = MainFrame

-- Helper function to build uniform directional buttons
local function createButton(name, pos, text)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = name
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 40)
    btn.Position = pos
    btn.Text = text
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Parent = ControlFrame
    return btn
end

-- Layout direction elements
local UpBtn    = createButton("UpBtn",    UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 5),   "Up")
local LeftBtn  = createButton("LeftBtn",  UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 50),  "Left")
local RightBtn = createButton("RightBtn", UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 50), "Right")
local DownBtn  = createButton("DownBtn",  UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 95),  "Down")

-- Global States & Physics Trackers
local flightActive = false
local isMinimized = false
local movementVelocity = nil
local rotationGyro = nil
local MOVEMENT_SPEED = 2 

-- References to the active character (changes when you die)
local currentCharacter = nil
local currentHumanoid = nil
local currentRootPart = nil

-- Core function to enable or disable physics setups
local function updatePhysicsState()
    if not currentCharacter or not currentHumanoid or not currentRootPart then return end
    
    -- Clean up any lingering objects from a previous character life
    if movementVelocity then movementVelocity:Destroy() movementVelocity = nil end
    if rotationGyro then rotationGyro:Destroy() rotationGyro = nil end
    
    if flightActive then
        FlightButton.Text = "DISABLE"
        FlightButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
        if not isMinimized then ControlFrame.Visible = true end
        
        currentHumanoid.WalkSpeed = MOVEMENT_SPEED
        
        -- Orient character flat immediately
        local flatTargetCFrame = currentRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
        currentRootPart.CFrame = flatTargetCFrame
        
        -- Apply locking forces
        rotationGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        rotationGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(4e5, 4e5, 4e5) 
        rotationGyro.D = 100 
        rotationGyro.P = 10000 
        rotationGyro.CFrame = flatTargetCFrame 
        rotationGyro.Parent = currentRootPart
        
        movementVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        movementVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6) 
        movementVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) 
        movementVelocity.Parent = currentRootPart
    else
        FlightButton.Text = "FLY (ENABLE)"
        FlightButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 180)
        ControlFrame.Visible = false
        
        currentHumanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
        currentRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentRootPart.Position)
    end
end

-- Hook up Character Re-binding loops (Fires every time you respawn)
local function onCharacterAdded(newCharacter)
    currentCharacter = newCharacter
    currentHumanoid = newCharacter:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    currentRootPart = newCharacter:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    -- Instantly enforce the flight/flat physics if it was left ON when you died
    updatePhysicsState()
end

-- Connect to existing character, and listen for future spawns
if LocalPlayer.Character then onCharacterAdded(LocalPlayer.Character) end
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)

-- Minimize/Maximize UI Logic
MinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isMinimized = not isMinimized
    if isMinimized then
        MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 40)
        ControlFrame.Visible = false
        MinBtn.Text = "+"
    else
        MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 200)
        if flightActive then ControlFrame.Visible = true end
        MinBtn.Text = "-"
    end
end)

-- Manual UI Toggle Button Press Listener
FlightButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    flightActive = not flightActive
    updatePhysicsState()
end)

-- Velocity Controller Direction mapping
local function applyPhysicsVelocity(directionVector)
    if not flightActive or not movementVelocity then return end
    movementVelocity.Velocity = directionVector * MOVEMENT_SPEED
end

-- Button click/tap bindings
UpBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)) end)
UpBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) end)

DownBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)) end)
DownBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) end)

LeftBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0)) end)
LeftBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) end)

RightBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)) end)
RightBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) end)

scripts.script:
-- Check for table that is shared between executions.
if not shared then
	return warn("No shared, no script.")
end

-- Detach previous instance.
if shared.SilentAim then
	shared.SilentAim.detach()
end

local SilentAim = {
	enabled = true,
	showFov = true,
	showHighlight = true,
	fovRadius = 200,
	targetPart = "Head",
	highlightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
	target = nil,

	espEnabled = true,
	espBoxes = true,
	espNames = true,
	espHealth = true,
	espChams = true,
	espNonEnemies = false,
	espMaxDistance = 1500,
	teamColors = {
		Police = Color3.fromRGB(60, 140, 255),
		Prisoner = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 40),
		Fugitive = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50),
	},
	defaultTeamColor = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220),
}

-- Constants.
local GUN_MODULE_NAME = "GunClient"

-- Services.
local playersService = game:GetService("Players")
local userInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local runService = game:GetService("RunService")

local localPlayer = playersService.LocalPlayer
local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- State.
local connections = {}
local espObjects = {}
local espFailed = {}
local espErrorLogged = false
local alive = true
local oldIndex = nil
local currentPart = nil
local rayfield = nil
local hiddenUi = gethui()
local fovCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
local targetHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

fovCircle.NumSides = 64
fovCircle.Thickness = 1
fovCircle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
fovCircle.Transparency = 1

targetHighlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
targetHighlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
targetHighlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
targetHighlight.Enabled = false
targetHighlight.Parent = hiddenUi

---Mirror the game's damage rules. Never call game code, it strips our capabilities.
---@param attackerTeam Team?
---@param victimTeam Team?
---@return boolean
local function canDamageTeam(attackerTeam, victimTeam)
	local attackerName = attackerTeam and attackerTeam.Name
	local victimName = victimTeam and victimTeam.Name

	if attackerName == "NoTeam" or victimName == "NoTeam" then
		return false
	end

	if attackerName == "Police" then
		return victimName ~= "Police"
	end

	if attackerName == "Prisoner" or attackerName == "Fugitive" then
		return victimName == "Police"
	end

	return true
end

---Get the color for a player's team.
---@param player Player
---@return Color3
local function getTeamColor(player)
	local team = player.Team
	if not team then
		return SilentAim.defaultTeamColor
	end

	return SilentAim.teamColors[team.Name] or team.TeamColor.Color
end

---Find the closest damageable enemy part to the cursor inside the FOV.
---@return BasePart?
local function getTargetPart()
	local closestPart, closestDistance = nil, SilentAim.fovRadius
	local mousePosition = userInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	local localTeam = localPlayer.Team

	for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
		if player == localPlayer then continue end
		if not canDamageTeam(localTeam, player.Team) then continue end

		local character = player.Character
		if not character then continue end

		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local part = character:FindFirstChild(SilentAim.targetPart)
		if not (humanoid and part and humanoid.Health > 0) then continue end

		local screenPosition, onScreen = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
		if not onScreen then continue end

		local distance = (Vector2.new(screenPosition.X, screenPosition.Y) - mousePosition).Magnitude
		if distance < closestDistance then
			closestDistance = distance
			closestPart = part
		end
	end

	return closestPart
end

---Create the chams and drawings for a player. Chams first so a parent failure leaks nothing.
---@param player Player
local function createEsp(player)
	local chams = Instance.new("Highlight")
	chams.FillTransparency = 0.75
	chams.OutlineTransparency = 0.3
	chams.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	chams.Enabled = false
	chams.Parent = hiddenUi

	local box = Drawing.new("Square")
	box.Thickness = 1
	box.Filled = false
	box.Transparency = 1

	local name = Drawing.new("Text")
	name.Size = 13
	name.Center = true
	name.Outline = true
	name.Transparency = 1

	local healthBar = Drawing.new("Line")
	healthBar.Thickness = 2
	healthBar.Transparency = 1

	espObjects[player] = { box = box, name = name, healthBar = healthBar, chams = chams }
end

---Hide every ESP element for a player.
---@param esp table
local function hideEsp(esp)
	esp.box.Visible = false
	esp.name.Visible = false
	esp.healthBar.Visible = false
	esp.chams.Enabled = false
	esp.chams.Adornee = nil
end

---Destroy a player's ESP.
---@param player Player
local function destroyEsp(player)
	espFailed[player] = nil

	local esp = espObjects[player]
	if not esp then return end

	espObjects[player] = nil
	esp.box:Remove()
	esp.name:Remove()
	esp.healthBar:Remove()
	esp.chams:Destroy()
end

---Update a player's ESP for this frame.
---@param player Player
---@param esp table
local function updateEsp(player, esp)
	if not SilentAim.espEnabled then
		return hideEsp(esp)
	end

	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not (humanoid and root and humanoid.Health > 0) then
		return hideEsp(esp)
	end

	if not SilentAim.espNonEnemies and not canDamageTeam(localPlayer.Team, player.Team) then
		return hideEsp(esp)
	end

	local distance = (currentCamera.CFrame.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
	if distance > SilentAim.espMaxDistance then
		return hideEsp(esp)
	end

	local rootScreen, onScreen = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
	if not onScreen then
		return hideEsp(esp)
	end

	local color = getTeamColor(player)
	local topScreen = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
	local bottomScreen = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0))
	local height = math.abs(topScreen.Y - bottomScreen.Y)
	local width = height / 1.8
	local left = rootScreen.X - width / 2

	esp.box.Visible = SilentAim.espBoxes
	esp.box.Color = color
	esp.box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
	esp.box.Position = Vector2.new(left, topScreen.Y)

	esp.name.Visible = SilentAim.espNames
	esp.name.Color = color
	esp.name.Text = string.format("%s [%dm]", player.Name, math.floor(distance))
	esp.name.Position = Vector2.new(rootScreen.X, topScreen.Y - 16)

	local healthRatio = math.clamp(humanoid.Health / math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
	esp.healthBar.Visible = SilentAim.espHealth
	esp.healthBar.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0), healthRatio)
	esp.healthBar.From = Vector2.new(left - 4, topScreen.Y + height)
	esp.healthBar.To = Vector2.new(left - 4, topScreen.Y + height - height * healthRatio)

	esp.chams.Enabled = SilentAim.espChams
	esp.chams.Adornee = character
	esp.chams.FillColor = color
	esp.chams.OutlineColor = color
end

---Detach the hooks, drawings and menu.
function SilentAim.detach()
	alive = false

	if oldIndex then
		hookmetamethod(game, "__index", oldIndex)
		oldIndex = nil
	end

	for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end

	for player in pairs(espObjects) do
		destroyEsp(player)
	end

	fovCircle:Remove()
	targetHighlight:Destroy()

	if rayfield then
		rayfield:Destroy()
	end

	shared.SilentAim = nil
end

---Build the Rayfield menu.

	local window = rayfield:CreateWindow({

	})

	local aimTab = window:CreateTab("Aim", 4483362458)

	aimTab:CreateToggle({

		CurrentValue = SilentAim.enabled,

	})

	aimTab:CreateKeybind({

		Callback = function() SilentAim.enabled = not SilentAim.enabled end,

	aimTab:CreateDropdown({

	})

	aimTab:CreateSlider({

	})

	aimTab:CreateToggle({

	})

	aimTab:CreateToggle({

	aimTab:CreateColorPicker({

	local espTab = window:CreateTab("ESP", 4483362458)

	espTab:CreateToggle({
		Name = "ESP",

	})

	espTab:CreateToggle({
		Name = "Boxes",
		CurrentValue = SilentAim.espBoxes,
		Callback = function(value) SilentAim.espBoxes = value end,

	espTab:CreateToggle({
		Name = "Names + Distance",
		CurrentValue = SilentAim.espNames,
		Callback = function(value) SilentAim.espNames = value end,
	})

	espTab:CreateToggle({
		Name = "Health Bar",
		CurrentValue = SilentAim.espHealth,
		Callback = function(value) SilentAim.espHealth = value end,
	})

	espTab:CreateToggle({
		Name = "Chams",
		CurrentValue = SilentAim.espChams,
		Callback = function(value) SilentAim.espChams = value end,
	})

	espTab:CreateToggle({
		Name = "Show Non-Enemies",
		CurrentValue = SilentAim.espNonEnemies,
		Callback = function(value) SilentAim.espNonEnemies = value end,
	})

	espTab:CreateSlider({
		Name = "Max Distance",
		Range = { 100, 3000 },
		Increment = 50,
		CurrentValue = SilentAim.espMaxDistance,
		Callback = function(value) SilentAim.espMaxDistance = value end,
	})

	local colorsTab = window:CreateTab("Team Colors", 4483362458)

	for _, teamName in ipairs({ "Police", "Prisoner", "Fugitive" }) do
		colorsTab:CreateColorPicker({
			Name = teamName,
			Color = SilentAim.teamColors[teamName],
			Callback = function(value) SilentAim.teamColors[teamName] = value end,
		})
	end
end

---Hook Mouse.Hit reads coming from the gun module and run the ESP.
local function init()
	oldIndex = hookmetamethod(game, "__index", newcclosure(function(self, key)
		if key ~= "Hit" or checkcaller() or not SilentAim.enabled or not currentPart then
			return oldIndex(self, key)
		end

		-- Only the gun module should see the spoofed value.
		local callingScript = getcallingscript()
		if not callingScript or callingScript.Name ~= GUN_MODULE_NAME then
			return oldIndex(self, key)
		end

		return CFrame.new(currentPart.Position)
	end))

	table.insert(connections, playersService.PlayerRemoving:Connect(destroyEsp))

	-- Create objects off the render thread, failures are logged once per player.
	task.spawn(function()
		while alive do
			for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
				if player == localPlayer or espObjects[player] or espFailed[player] then continue end

				local success, err = pcall(createEsp, player)
				if not success then
					espFailed[player] = true
					warn("ESP create failed:", player.Name, err)
				end
			end

			task.wait(0.25)
		end
	end)

	table.insert(connections, runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		fovCircle.Radius = SilentAim.fovRadius
		fovCircle.Position = userInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		fovCircle.Visible = SilentAim.enabled and SilentAim.showFov

		currentPart = SilentAim.enabled and getTargetPart() or nil
		SilentAim.target = currentPart

		if currentPart and SilentAim.showHighlight then
			targetHighlight.Adornee = currentPart.Parent
			targetHighlight.FillColor = SilentAim.highlightColor
			targetHighlight.OutlineColor = SilentAim.highlightColor
			targetHighlight.Enabled = true
		else
			targetHighlight.Enabled = false
			targetHighlight.Adornee = nil
		end

		for player, esp in pairs(espObjects) do
			local success, err = pcall(updateEsp, player, esp)
			if not success and not espErrorLogged then
				espErrorLogged = true
				warn("ESP update failed:", err)
			end
		end
	end))
end

---Handle init errors.
---@param error string
local function onInitError(error)
	warn("Failed to init.")
	warn(error)
	warn(debug.traceback())
	SilentAim.detach()
end

shared.SilentAim = SilentAim
xpcall(init, onInitError)
xpcall(createMenu, function(error) warn("Menu failed:", error) end)
